erDiagram
    MASTER_DATASET {
        VARCHAR(12) master_id PK
        VARCHAR hubspot_id
        VARCHAR account_id
        VARCHAR vitally_id
        VARCHAR company_name
        VARCHAR domain
        VARCHAR domain_label
        VARCHAR segment
        VARCHAR plan
        VARCHAR industry
        VARCHAR state
        VARCHAR csm_owner
        DATE signup_date
        DATE churn_date
        VARCHAR churn_status
        VARCHAR reference_month
        VARCHAR confidence_tier
        DECIMAL mrr_mxn
        VARCHAR mrr_source
        VARCHAR mrr_confidence
        DECIMAL mrr_original
        VARCHAR currency_original
        DECIMAL trend_usage
        VARCHAR trend_asof_month
        VARCHAR trend_status
        INTEGER usage_months
        INTEGER active_users_latest
        DECIMAL active_users_avg
        INTEGER tickets_total
        INTEGER tickets_urgent
        DECIMAL csat_avg
        VARCHAR acquisition_channel
        DECIMAL closed_revenue_mxn
        VARCHAR ruleset_version
        DATE dataset_asof
    }

    IDENTITY_CROSSWALK {
        VARCHAR(12) master_id PK
        VARCHAR hubspot_id
        VARCHAR account_id
        VARCHAR vitally_id
        VARCHAR account_match_tier
        VARCHAR vitally_match_tier
        VARCHAR confidence_tier
        DATE resolved_at
        VARCHAR ruleset_version
    }

    MATCH_AUDIT {
        VARCHAR source_system
        VARCHAR source_id
        VARCHAR(12) master_id FK
        VARCHAR tier
        DECIMAL score
        DECIMAL score_runner_up
        DECIMAL score_margin
        INTEGER candidate_count
        VARCHAR blocking_rule
        VARCHAR evidence_json
        BOOLEAN veto_applied
        VARCHAR veto_reason
        BOOLEAN needs_review
        VARCHAR ruleset_version
        VARCHAR decided_by
        DATE decided_at
    }

    QUARANTINE_COMPANIES {
        VARCHAR hubspot_id PK
        VARCHAR company_name
        VARCHAR domain
        DECIMAL mrr
        VARCHAR currency
        DATE signup_date
        DATE churn_date
        VARCHAR reason_code
        VARCHAR survivor_hubspot_id
        VARCHAR(12) survivor_master_id FK
        VARCHAR evidence_json
        VARCHAR ruleset_version
        DATE decided_at
    }

    QUARANTINE_DEALS {
        VARCHAR deal_id PK
        VARCHAR hubspot_id
        VARCHAR stage
        DECIMAL amount
        DATE created_date
        DATE close_date
        VARCHAR pipeline
        VARCHAR lead_source
        VARCHAR reason_code
        VARCHAR ruleset_version
        DATE decided_at
    }

    EXCEPTIONS_LOG {
        VARCHAR(12) exception_id PK
        VARCHAR exception_code
        VARCHAR source_system
        VARCHAR source_id
        VARCHAR(12) master_id FK
        VARCHAR field_name
        VARCHAR original_value
        VARCHAR applied_value
        VARCHAR evidence_ref
        VARCHAR ruleset_version
        DATE decided_at
    }

    COMPANIES {
        VARCHAR hubspot_id PK
    }

    ACCOUNTS {
        VARCHAR account_id PK
    }

    CUSTOMERS {
        VARCHAR vitally_id PK
    }

    IDENTITY_CROSSWALK ||--|| MASTER_DATASET : "master_id, 1 a 1"
    COMPANIES ||--|| IDENTITY_CROSSWALK : "hubspot_id, obligatorio en las 650 filas"
    IDENTITY_CROSSWALK |o--o| ACCOUNTS : "account_id, nulo en 82 de 650"
    IDENTITY_CROSSWALK |o--o| CUSTOMERS : "vitally_id, nulo sin cliente Vitally vinculado"
    COMPANIES ||--o{ MATCH_AUDIT : "source_system = crm_hubspot"
    ACCOUNTS ||--o{ MATCH_AUDIT : "source_system = product_db"
    CUSTOMERS ||--o{ MATCH_AUDIT : "source_system = vitally"
    MATCH_AUDIT }o--o| MASTER_DATASET : "master_id, nulo en tier Q"
    QUARANTINE_COMPANIES }o--|| MASTER_DATASET : "survivor_master_id"
    EXCEPTIONS_LOG }o--o| MASTER_DATASET : "master_id, nulo segun exception_code"
